QuestInfo.name: Phoning a Friend
QuestInfo.0: This is a job for someone with brains. You'd better radio for #bConey#k's help.
QuestInfo.1: Assuming the worst, #bConey#k rushes over to help. You should explain the situation.
QuestInfo.2: Coney told you to pay for the request according to the branch rules.

0.msg: I don't have time for this... Hmm. Maybe I can get some other stooge to crack the safe for me. That one guy at the hideout seemed the brainy type.\r\n

2.msg: Cadena to Coney, do you read? I, uh, ran into trouble on a mission. I need you to get here as fast as you can. Write this address down...\r\n

3.msg: Huh? What? Cadena! Wh-what's going on? Okay, I'll be there s-s-soon!\r\n

5.msg: Haha. He sounded scared. Maybe I should've been less dramatic. I could call him back... But where's the fun in that?\r\n

0.msg: Cadena, I'm sorry I'm late. What's the t-t-trouble?\r\n

1.msg: Wow, did you really run all the way here? You're, uh, really sweating...\r\n

2.msg: Geez. There's no need to hurt yourself. I just need your brains.\r\n

no.0: Uh... He looks worried. Should I tell him that it's nothing serious?\r\n

0.msg: #b(You ask Coney to crack the code of Antuin's safe.)#k\r\n

Wh-what? You had me rush over for this?! (Sighs) I'm sorry, but I c-can't do it for free. The Shadowdealer Code states that you should never give anything away without getting something in return!\r\n

1.msg: H-how about a deal. If you help me with m-my mission, I'll help you with yours.\r\n

2.msg: I mean, I'm so behind on much of my research, surely there's s-something you c-could do for m-m-me.\r\n

3.msg: Ugh, everybody's such a stickler for the rules. Fine, let's make a deal.

default.0: Haha. He sounded scared. Maybe I should've been less dramatic. I could call him back... But where's the fun in that?\r\n
